claim: The six model classes, organized by the engineering questions they answer.

topology.description: Six peer model classes; separate orthogonal representation-form axis.

required_terms: Behavioral What may happen? In what order?
Ownership Who controls? For how long?
Decision What is allowed? Which choice?
Representation form Graph · registry · state machine · contract · table · quantitative relation
Shared identity and traceability connect explicit engineering knowledge.
bw_encoding: All six purpose classes white and equal; the separate form axis supplies the other distinction.
redesign: All six purpose classes white and equal; the separate form axis supplies the other distinction. Existing horizontal/vertical paths retained; no diagonal process-routing exception.
alt: Six peer boxes list structural, behavioral, ownership, decision, measurement and provenance models with the questions each answers. A separate representation-form axis lists graph, registry, state machine, contract, table and quantitative relation. Model purpose and representation form are distinct; shared identity and traceability connect the models.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Common model-class gray distinguishes six peer purposes from the representation-form axis; no artificial rank among classes.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors
